newsitem.title: USA: RTRS - IMF puts off decision on gold sales until Sept 18.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - IMF puts off decision on gold sales until Sept 18.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund on Friday put off a decision on a controversial proposal to sell a small amount of its gold to help the world's poorest nations until next week.
IMF Managing Director Michel Camdessus termed Friday's board discussion on ways to help the world's poorest nations "extremely cooperative and constructive.
"We will continue in the same spirit to conclude the work of the executive board next Wednesday, September 18," he said in a brief statement.

IMF management, backed by the United States, Britain and most other member nations, has proposed selling around five million of the Fund's 104 million ounces of gold to help finance stepped-up assistance to poor countries.
But a few nations -- Germany, Italy and Switzerland -- have opposed the proposal, arguing in part that the IMF should not sell gold except in cases of extreme financial emergency.
